name: normalize_window
description: Normalize a windowed segment [inpoint, outpoint) of a video clip to the project's working color space + codec. Uses input-level fast seek (-ss/-t before -i) so only the requested window is decoded — the output starts at time 0 and is dense-keyframe conformant (same GOP contract as the full normalize step). Handles SDR↔HDR colorspace conversion via zscale when needed.

input.description: Source video file (any codec/color space; probed automatically)

output.description: Normalized segment clip conformant to the project color space, starting at time 0

params.name: input
params.description: Path to the source video file

params.name: inpoint
params.description: Start of the window to extract (seconds into the source)

params.name: outpoint
params.description: End of the window to extract (seconds into the source)

params.name: color-space
params.description: Project color space key: sdr_bt709, hdr_hlg, or hdr_pq (default: sdr_bt709)

params.name: out
params.description: Output path for the normalized windowed segment
